explanation: The lemma says that updating the "else" branch of a dependent dite function (over a subtype ¬P) equals updating the whole function. I searched Mathlib for dite/update lemmas (dite_comp_equiv_update, updateFinset lemmas, Function.update_dite-style names) and found nothing matching. The closest, `dite_comp_equiv_update` in Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Set.lean, covers only the non-dependent case and the "then" branch, so it does not apply to dependent M₁ i. The only related declaration is the sibling `domDomRestrict_aux`, which the proof already uses.
